title: Otori Emu — Hyper★Positive〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We still have some time before the live show starts. Wanna drop by Ken's place for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey hey hey! You guys over there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There's a guy in this school who goes Hahahaha! and strikes weird poses out of nowhere, right?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? We don't have someone so crazy in thi—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yes, that's him!
Do you know what class he's in?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's in 2-A. Go up those stairs there and turn right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wh-What was that all about? And she's clearly not a student of this school. Why'd you tell her where the classroom was?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She knows Tsukasa, so it'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: On the contrary... That's even worse.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I have nothing but bad feelings about this.
Hey, let's just head over to Ken's before we get dragged into anything.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But I can't hear what they're saying.
If only I had Robo-Nene with me...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mhm? That girl just now really looked like Robo-Nene...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I know! She must be a look-alike!
Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hi, Tsukasa! So we're going to discuss our plans for the stage production in this classroom?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. There's no one else around at the moment so it's the perfect spot, really. We have plenty of things to do even on inspection day! Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, if it isn't Emu! Welcome to our school.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why are you welcoming her like this is perfectly normal?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In the first place, Emu! You're not even a student of this—

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Oh, it's you two. Some students outside said they heard the strange squealing of someone from another school just now. Do you guys know anything about that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
N-No, sir! We didn't see anything!
Absolutely nothing at all!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Really? Well if you do see anything, let me know.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, was he talking about me just now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Who else could it be?! This is really bad.
We need to get you out before you're—

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Go home soon if you have nothing to do here, okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes! We're going! We're going right now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sigh... I almost had a heart attack...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Are you okay? You look so tired.
Do you wanna hear me sing a happy song?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ugh... Why take the trouble to come all the way here anyway?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because I'm the only one in a different school, the stage is closed so we can't practice today, and it's no fair that I don't get to meet everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We should find a place where we can still meet together even on days with no practice sessions.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That would allow us to discuss things like the script and practice menu together at any time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, I guess we could go to a nearby diner for today...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! Let's go to that diner, like right now♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey! Don't just step out without checking first!
What if the teachers see you?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ I can't help myself because I'm so happy♪
